out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED MAJORITY OF EMPLOYEES NOT TO HAVE SIGNED AN EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY IN CHINESE PROVIDED OVER EMAIL. PLEASE PRINT OUT A COPY FOR EACH EMPLOYEE AND HAVE THEM READ AND SIGN.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed in the walk-in cooler, raw shell eggs, being stored above, ready to eat vegetables
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge moved the raw shell eggs away from the ready to eat vegetables and started with other raw animal proteins

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: the two door prep top cooler did not have a thermometer in the cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Person in charge acquired and replace the thermometer for the two door pep top cooler.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knife, being stored inside a homemade sheath that was made out of cardboard, duct tape, and plastic wrap.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge disposed of homemade sheath made out of cardboard, plastic wrap, and duct tape. Mama's Taste (Inspection Date: 11/13/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knife on the cook line, being stored in between a prep top cooler and a in use counter
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge remove the knife from in between the prep top cooler and the counter had it washed and sanitized reviewed proper in use utensil storage with EHS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: compressor in the walk-in cooler does not have a ventilation grate below the compressor unit and above food storage
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Person in charge agreed to have the walk-in cooler ventilation grate repaired or replaced

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: observed throughout the kitchen raw untreated lumber was being used as a non-food contact surface to support equipment and other materials inside the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. Person in charge agreed to discontinue use of non-treated unsealed lumber in the facility.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed throughout the kitchen cardboard being used as shelf shelf liners
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Person in charge agreed to discontinue use of cardboard as shelf liners agreed to find solution that is a durable cleanable non-food contact surface.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Pic arrived later during inspection

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the 3 compartment sink area is blocked by stools and buckets of sauce, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS asked employee to remove items so the handwashing sink could be accessed. PIC removed items.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink by the 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS informed PIC of lack of hand soap at handwashing sink. PIC replaced soap. Mama's Taste (Inspection Date: 06/03/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front counter being used to store wet wiping rags and gloves
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS informed PIC that handwashing are designated use for handwashing only. PiC removed items from handwashing sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw Chicken being stored on a shelf above RTE vegetables.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS informed PIC of issue, PIC had employees move food so chicken could not contaminate the RTE vegetables

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Meat slicer and food tray was washed in the 1 compartment prep sink, not the designated 3 compartment sink using a wash rinse sanitize procedure.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS informed PIC, PIC stopped employee and had employee rewash meat slicer and tray int he 3 compartment sink using a wash rinse and sanitize procedure

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: EHS observed OTC medicines and isopropyl alcohol being stored over food prep surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EHS informed PIC that personal care items and medicine could not be stored over food prep areas where they might contaminate the food.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Rice, salt, sugar and MSG
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS informed pic that foods in non original containers needed to have common name labels, Agreed to label food by next inspection.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PIC agreed to acquire a covered trash can.

violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the BACK DISH AREA is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. EHS OBSERVED BACK HANDSINK NEAR DISH AREA BLOCKED BY STOOL AND POT OF SOUP AND STORAGE OF BUCKETS.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC CLEARED PATH TO HANDSINK.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2DR PREP TOP COOLER. EHS OBSERVED 2DR PREP TOP COOLER AT 55F. UNIT WAS NOT ON DEFROST.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED ALL TCS FOODS IN 2DR PREP TOP TO OTHER COOLERS ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F. PIC WILL NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN 2DR PREP TOP COOLER UNTIL COOLER IS REPAIRED AND ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F.
